inputSpec.name: regions
inputSpec.label: regions
inputSpec.help: BED file of panel regions (see readme for format)

inputSpec.name: coverage_files
inputSpec.label: coverage files
inputSpec.help: Array of mosdepth / samtools output files, expects per base bed and reference build txt file

inputSpec.name: normal_coverage
inputSpec.label: normal coverage
inputSpec.help: tsv of per base normal coverage previously generated from Athena. Requires -ihsmetrics.

inputSpec.name: hsmetrics
inputSpec.label: hsmetrics
inputSpec.help: hsmetrics file, required to be provided if using -inormal_coverage

inputSpec.name: thresholds
inputSpec.label: thresholds
inputSpec.help: Threshold values at which to calculate coverage

inputSpec.name: build
inputSpec.label: build
inputSpec.help: genome build the data is for

inputSpec.name: name
inputSpec.label: name
inputSpec.help: Sample name, used in report and for naming output files

inputSpec.name: limit
inputSpec.label: limit
inputSpec.help: Skip full gene plot generation when the number of genes exceeds this limit. Use -1 for no limit.

inputSpec.name: plot_sub_threshold
inputSpec.label: plot sub threshold
inputSpec.help: Adds interactive plots of regions under threshold defined by --minimum

inputSpec.name: plot_chromosomes
inputSpec.label: plot chromosomes
inputSpec.help: Adds section of full chromosome plots

inputSpec.name: indication
inputSpec.label: indication
inputSpec.help: String of clinical indication to display in clinical summary text

inputSpec.name: panel
inputSpec.label: panel
inputSpec.help: Panel(s) / gene(s) to display in summary, will default to name of panel bed file

inputSpec.name: panel_filters
inputSpec.label: panel filters
inputSpec.help: Drop down gene panel filters for full gene plots, should be given as panel1:gene1,gene2,gene3

inputSpec.name: snps
inputSpec.label: SNP VCFs to check coverage for
inputSpec.help: Array of VCF files containing SNPs to check coverage for. Supports both .vcf and .vcf.gz formats.

inputSpec.name: summary
inputSpec.label: Report summary
inputSpec.help: Display summary of genes / transcripts in report in summary section. Default: False

inputSpec.name: summary_file
inputSpec.label: Make report summary file
inputSpec.help: Output text in summary section to a text file. Default: False

inputSpec.name: write_data
inputSpec.label: write data
inputSpec.help: Controls if to write out the gene, region and per base data to files

outputSpec.name: region_coverage
outputSpec.label: Summarised per region stats file
outputSpec.help: tsv of summarised per region coverage

outputSpec.name: gene_coverage
outputSpec.label: Summarised per gene stats file
outputSpec.help: tsv of summarised per gene coverage

outputSpec.name: annotated_bed
outputSpec.label: Annotated BED file
outputSpec.help: Full annotated bed file of per base coverage

outputSpec.name: summary_text
outputSpec.label: Summary text
outputSpec.help: Summary of genes/transcripts in coverage report. Creation of this file is controlled by the summary_file input boolean.
